name: Rohit M S
description:
Rohit M S is an AWS Certified Solutions Architect and DevOps/Backend Engineer with over 8 years of experience building and automating cloud infrastructure. His expertise spans the full DevOps lifecycle — CI/CD pipeline design with Jenkins, GitHub, Docker, and Kubernetes, plus infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and Ansible across AWS and Azure. He has architected highly available, fault-tolerant systems using EC2, EKS, Lambda, S3, and DynamoDB, alongside monitoring solutions built on Prometheus and Grafana.

Beyond infrastructure engineering, he has hands-on experience with IoT data pipelines, microservices communication architecture, and distributed computing research. His technical foundation includes strong programming in Core Java, C/C++, and Python, backed by an MTech in Engineering.

Earlier in his career, he independently built and led an education-sector automation platform, and separately engineered an algorithmic trading system using technical indicators like RSI and EMA — reflecting a builder's mindset spanning both enterprise infrastructure and entrepreneurial product work.
